#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[René Finger] (Faculty of Psychology & Neuroscience, Maastricht University) – [October 16, 2024, 1:08 PM]:**

- *Key quote:* "We would like to continue our Ethica license in 2025, under the same conditions as this year. Could you please send me a quote for the license in 2025."  

- **[Sara Farnya] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – [October 19, 2024, 4:15 AM]:**
